item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports community centres, media participation, disability-related strategies and programmes, child-protection provisions, the 2018–2030 child strategy, a hotline, and access to health, educational and social rights for children with disabilities."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the listed health, education, rehabilitation, screening, vaccination, integration, tablet-distribution and language-service measures, including the quantities 130 and 245."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports measures attributed to the Ministry of Justice, Public Prosecutor and government institutions concerning complaints, investigations, inspections, media, sign-language interpretation and accessibility."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The government reported disability-accessible public services and programmes, integrated inclusive community centres targeting remote and poor areas, accessibility measures at parliamentary facilities, and other accessibility initiatives.","notes":["The excerpt supports inclusive community centres, remote and poor area targeting, and accessible parliamentary facilities.","The quantities 31, 112, three, and 70, and the proposed National Academy of Information Technology initiative, are not supported by this exact excerpt and were removed."]}]}
